_note: The music box: a collectable that is wound from the pack (game/music_box.rs). boxes_per_region is the count of boxes per route region (GameConfig.MUSIC_BOXES_PER_REGION, game_config.gd:546). wound_seconds is the wound time by difficulty id (GameConfig.MUSIC_BOX_WOUND_SECONDS). winddown_seconds is the last stretch where Glyra turns restless and the HUD warns (MusicBoxes.mood_for); it no longer drives the tune. slowdown_from_fraction is the share of the wound time left below which the tune slows (0.70 = it plays at normal speed down to 70 %, then eases down as the wind drains, and stops at 0); slowdown_floor is the speed it has just before the box empties (a factor of normal tempo and pitch). tune_gain scales the tune against the master bus.
_wind_note: wind_seconds is the hold time from empty to 100%; overwind_seconds is how long past 100% before the box jams; jam_cooldown_seconds is the lock-out after a jam; jam_noise and jam_noise_seconds are the noise burst hunters hear; prompt_ and message_ are the upper-case texts.
message_left_click: HOLD [E] TO WIND THE MUSIC BOX
